Exact precision-recall curve at a target prevalence

Source: R/fn_average_precision.R
pr_curve_exact.Rd

Full PR curve from point-level predictions, case-weighted to prevalence pi with reweight. The point-level analogue of ap_pointwise (which integrates this curve).

Usage

pr_curve_exact(truth, prob, pi)

Arguments

truth

Outcomes coded 1 / 0.

prob

Predicted probabilities/scores.

pi

Target prevalence in (0, 1).

Value

data.frame with columns recall and precision, ordered by descending score.
